journey.name: Delete conversation: confirm, then it is gone
journey.description: Deleting is destructive and local-only, so it asks first and then the conversation is gone from the list.

actions.action: Type "Reply with exactly: Hello" into the message field and tap send
Wait until a reply bubble appears containing "Hello"
Tap the "More" button in the top bar
Verify a dialog titled "Delete this chat?" is displayed
Verify the conversation list no longer contains that conversation
